openHint: Double-click or Enter: open in a new tab · drag onto a pane's edge to split it
emptyBody: Pick a host on the left to open a shell.
emptyNoHosts: Add a host to open your first shell. Hosts are saved with your tunnels and travel with config export and import.
echoHint: Time from your last keystroke to the server's reply
excludeFromBroadcast: Receiving broadcast — click to leave this pane out
includeInBroadcast: Left out of broadcast — click to include
dividerHint: Drag to resize · double-click to split evenly
broadcastOnHint: Broadcast: type into every pane of this tab (Ctrl+Shift+B)
pasteConfirmMessage: This pastes {{lines}} lines into {{targets}} panes at once. Each line may run as a command.

unsavedClose.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedClose.message: These files have changes that are not saved. Closing now discards them.
unsavedClose.saveFailed: Could not save, so nothing was closed.

dragPaneHint: Drag to move this pane: onto another pane's edge, another tab, or the tab bar
mouseSelectTooltip: The program on the server wants the mouse; dragging selects and copies instead. Click to give the mouse to the program.
mouseAppTooltip: The program on the server (tmux, vim, htop…) has the mouse. Click to take it back so dragging always selects.
staleTargetHint: This shell was opened before the host was edited. Press Enter after it ends (or open a new pane) to connect as {{saved}}.

smart.runHint: Run them all, one after another, each after the previous one finishes
smart.insertHint: Put it at the prompt without running it (Alt+Enter)
smart.insertFirstHint: Put the first command at the prompt (Alt+Enter); the next ones are offered as you go
smart.tabHintAfter: Tab is the shell's own completion

workspace.title: Workspaces
workspace.save: Save open tabs as a workspace
workspace.saveHint: {{tabs}} tab(s), {{panes}} pane(s). Opening it later starts a new shell in every pane. Saving under an existing name replaces it.
workspace.openHint: Open its tabs · right-click for more
workspace.changedHint: Unsaved changes in “{{name}}”: click for save options

layout.syncScrollOff: Panes scroll together · click to stop

watch.focusedSilence: This pane: notify after 30 s of silence
watch.firedTab: A watched pane needs a look
watch.armedOutput: Watching for output · click to change
watch.armedSilence: Watching for 30 s of silence · click to change
watch.firedOutput: New output in this watched pane · click to change the watch
watch.firedSilence: This watched pane has been silent for 30 s · click to change the watch
watch.notifySilenceBody: A watched pane has stopped printing.

select.openFamilyTooMany: Open with its {{count}} child hosts (more than {{max}} panes)

group.openAllTooMany: Open all in one tab (over {{max}}, pick some)

files.pathHint: Double-click or Ctrl+L to type a path

files.uploadHint: Upload files here (or drop them on this panel)
files.cutCount_one: {{count}} item cut — paste with Ctrl+V to move
files.cutCount_other: {{count}} items cut — paste with Ctrl+V to move

pos.tl: Snap to top left of its shell
pos.tr: Snap to top right of its shell

pos.br: Snap to bottom right of its shell

del.title: Delete from {{where}}?
del.count: {{files}} files and {{dirs}} folders will be deleted.
del.countMore: More than {{files}} files and {{dirs}} folders will be deleted.
del.noTrash: Servers have no trash: this cannot be undone.
